result.note: Brief item; tested the Cabinet's July 2026 approval of funding for chemical parks, the only concrete checkable fact.

questions.prompt: In July 2026, the Union Cabinet cleared INR 30.3 billion (USD 314 million) for how many chemical parks?
questions.explain: The Cabinet cleared INR 30.3 billion (USD 314 million) for three chemical parks on 27 July 2026. Its land and funding conditions favour states that already hold chemical capacity.
questions.source: The Cabinet cleared INR 30.3 billion (USD 314 million) for three chemical parks, with land and funding gates that favour the states already holding chemical capacity.
